brief: Design an interface for a "Sleep Debt Calculator" that visualizes accumulated sleep deficit as a physical architectural structure that gradually crumbles and repairs itself—imagine a delicate paper ca

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphorical concept—paper pyramid as fragile sleep architecture creates immediate visceral and poetic resonance with the brief
Restrained monochrome palette with a single gold accent gives the night-sky aesthetic atmospheric, contemplative gravity
Tiny typographic system (labels, hours unit) is confident, well-tracked, and respects negative space
dominant_weaknesses: Composition is unbalanced—floating top triangle feels orphaned, and ghostly background shards read as render artifacts rather than intentional debris
Behavioral clarity is weak: how '14 hours' debt maps to the structure's damage, or how to log/repair sleep, is not legible
Legend (DEEP/REM/LIGHT) and the 1–8 quality scale are disconnected from the central visualization, breaking the data-to-form contract
fix_priorities: Tie debt hours directly to visible structural decay—cracks, missing fragments, leaning—so the metaphor becomes a readable gauge
Resolve the floating upper triangle and background shards into a coherent crumbling/repairing system with intentional staging
Connect DEEP/REM/LIGHT legend to colored strata within the pyramid so sleep quality data drives the form
Add a clear input affordance for logging last night's sleep beyond the abstract 1–8 row
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and reflective pull from the paper-architecture metaphor, but behavioral layer is underdeveloped—users sense mood faster than they understand the data.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the poetic spirit of fragile sleep architecture beautifully, but the crumble/repair mechanic isn't yet legibly tied to the debt number, so the brief is half-delivered.
